pdf_page_count raises an error when the input is not a PDF

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*

fun main() {
    try {
    val result = Xberg.pdfPageCount(java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(java.nio.file.Paths.get("this is not a pdf document")), null)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}
```
